what: Planned run-log fallback only suppresses RUN_ID=unknown, but failed-publish with a real run id still gets a synthetic larch-logs path
scenario_or_breakage: When design-log publish fails after a non-empty SESSION_ID, render-final-summary passes RUN_LOGS_PATH=N/A for outcome failed-publish, then render-run-summary rebuilds larch-logs/design/<run-id>/ and advertises logs that did not publish
suggested_fix: Extend the proposed guard to also skip fallback for failed-publish, and add a real-run-id failed-publish test alongside the unknown-run-id case
